opportunities.title: ADC — O&M of the Aqaba Marine Terminal (Jordan) — tender cancelled
opportunities.scope: Tender for the Operation and Maintenance of the Aqaba Marine Terminal. EPROM scored strongly in the technical evaluation before the client cancelled the tender.
opportunities.lastFollowUpText:
Status: DISAPPROVED / cancelled by the client. Date of communication: 08/2026.

Reason / remarks: ADC has cancelled the tender for the Operation and Maintenance of the Aqaba Marine Terminal. We had previously achieved a strong score in the technical evaluation. It is believed that the cancellation may be related to the ongoing regional security situation.
Action needed: Monitor for the re-publication of the tender and participate once the opportunity is re-launched.

Recorded as Cancelled, not Lost — the client withdrew the tender; this was not a price or technical loss and must not count against the win rate.

(Source: International Department — Global Entity Qualification & Registration Status, 16/08/2026, prepared by Eng. AbdelRahman Ali.)
